source.snippet: I am looking for a FAQ engine for a project. I have installed phpMyFaq. But it's too slow, I have already fixed 4 serious bugs in its code, it has more. It's too feature rich. I am looking for: Preferably PHP and MySQL, Free or low one-off cost, Need heading, body, keywords, categories and attachments, Login required for editing, SSO support will be a bonus, running on Windows server.

problem_statement: Businesses running PHP/MySQL stacks on Windows Server need a simple, fast, self-hosted FAQ/knowledge-base engine, but the available open-source options are either too bloated, buggy, or abandoned — leaving teams patching code themselves.
target_segment: Web developers and IT managers at SMBs or internal IT departments running Windows Server with PHP/MySQL stacks.
notes: Buyer is a developer/IT role at a business, already spending time fixing bugs in existing software — classic willingness-to-pay scenario for a clean, maintained alternative. Low-one-off-cost signals price sensitivity but not zero budget. Niche but recurring.
